{{Quote|Ah, yes. Kara. She's not openly affiliated with the Stargazers. But she's incredibly rich &mdash; made her fortune in swing dust mining &mdash; and it's whispered that she funds them, lets them stay in properties she owns around Rhol Yan and beyond. '''Swing dust''' was a variant of [[air spice]] that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] in the [[Unidentified Kalimahr air mines|air mines]] at the north pole of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. It was used as food additive, a local Kalimahr [[Unidentified wine (Kalimahr)|wine]] was fortified with swing dust.<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Swing dust was first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
